author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Open data day was a huge success. We ran programs with three organizations in Accra.

What is a community?
Building these long term partnership help make your future organizations strong.
But remember it only takes 2-3 people meeting regularly to be an organization. That is one major lesson we want people to take away from our program. Do not waste time talking about being an organization or planning for a distant future.


Just be an organization. Have a shared vision with a group of people and push each other to grow. Get together and do the work. You learn as you work , repeat what works, and stop doing what does not work.


More importantly you learn as a person while contributing to a network of growing knowledge that itself gets smarter as you help the community grow.


Next OER Ghana Meet Up


We could not get the remote set up working with technology and schedules on Open Data Day for a remote OER Ghana IndieWeb MeetUp get together. Sadik ran a session during Open Data Day about our program.We do want to get together with our Navrongo friends.


We will hold two different meet ups on Tuesday but the content will be the same. We will do the first three challenges: https://goifnetwork.org/module1.html
To learn more about the meet up visit: https://events.indieweb.org/2020/03/oer-ghana-indieweb-meet-up-navrongo-IIzqETOHf1n8

We look forward to seeing everyone again this week.
